1.4.1-beta.2 (#1528)

* 🚩 Updated Dutch language
- Fixed a freeze issue

* Feat RTL styles & arabic locale (#1506)

* add arabic locale

* add RTL functionality

* add stylelint and force using css logical properties

* adjust the current theme to use css logical properties

* fix CSS linting issues

* 🚩 Updated Chinese language

* Added code to sync with Chums (#1513)

Co-authored-by: Kristoffer Vassbø <kristoffervassbo@gmail.com>

* ✔️ Fixed freeze with dynamic values sometimes

* Sigint & sigterm listeners

* 🖼️ Convert PDF to images again
- Fixed PDF memory issue
- Fixed Clipboard importing not working
- Fixed shows not properly backed up always

* Fix/rtl edit position (#1519)

* use css logical properties

* fix edit position in rtl direction

* 📱 RemoteShow updates
- Create show from remote
- Fixed active show not highlighted in remote
- Remote shows list auto scroll to active
- Search is remembered in remote
- Add opened show to project from remote
- Start screen action
- Fixed files not syncing to cloud initially

* ✨ Triggered actions history
- Slide action can override category action
- Fixed flickering dynamic values in StageShow

* fix resizing in rtl layouts (#1521)

* Fixed RTL snap line x position

* ✨ Stage item conditions
- Fixed some dynamic values not working in stage output
- Async backup
- Fixed video time variable not working in stage output
- Fixed items stacking if same slide is presented or variable updates

* ✨ OSC data input
- Fixed project import not replacing existing projects/shows
- Fixed verse does not exist popup
- Fixed API scripture incorrect chapter

* ✔️ Fixed stage resolution sometimes incorrect
- Fixed stage textbox content not always refreshing properly in preview

* Linting files (#1525)

* ESLint & linted electron files

* Auto linting frontend

* Auto linting svelte

* Linting frontend

* Linting svelte

* 📂 Organizing config files

* ✔️ Fixed unable to change scripture version from remote

* Version update

---------

introduction.message:
1.6.2-beta.2 (#3364)

* Show Style custom First slide template in preview

* More uniform tips

* Updated Chinese language

* Moved Log song usage to Shows drawer
- Clock visible more often

* Shows Cleaning utility
- Fixed auto delete empty shows not working with many

* Moved media tools from settings>Other to Media drawer

* Settings info tweak

* OBS Studio toggle in settings>Connection
- Tweaks

* Fixed missing media sometimes not located when played

* Create show category icons
- Tweaks

* Fix

* Colored grid mode

* Fixed PDF landscape export #3342

* Fixed show header text overflow width

* Fix: resolve controlshow bug where current slide in draw mode isn't updated when slides are updated using the controller (#3344)

* Enhanced some tips

* fix(spotify): repair Linux MPRIS controls, seek and progress bar (#3357)

On Linux all Spotify controller commands go through dbus-send, which had
three issues:

- Controls (play/pause, next, prev) were sent without --type=method_call,
  so dbus-send defaulted to "signal" and the player ignored them.
- Seek used the invalid dbus-send type "x64:" instead of "int64:".
- Position was parsed with /uint64/, which matched mpris:length (duration)
  instead of the int64 Position property, pinning the progress bar at 100%.

Tested on Ubuntu 26.04 and 25.10 (GNOME/Wayland, native Spotify client).

* fix(sync): merge SYNCED_SETTINGS collections per-item via the created/deleted ledger (#3354)

* Fix chord layout autosizing (#3352)

* Add stage layout import and export (#3353)

* Fix Windows output visibility during Aero Peek (#3360)

* Fixed BMD output not working

* Fixed frame sometimes not updating #3362

* Fixed audio paused state not always updating #3359

* Fixed Planning Center chords import #3348

* Fixed {slide_text_ item order
- Fixed slide_text not getting empty items

* Fixed errors

* Fixed errors

* Set custom fade out duration

* Fixed media not loading on zoom
- Column of 2 now loads the full media

* Fixed NDI audio being choppy

* test(sync): unit tests + pure SyncLedger module for per-item SYNCED_SETTINGS merge (#3335) (#3355)

* Version update

---------
